turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clearer if you face me and talk slowly.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not felt right lately, my chest is bothering me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It feels like a heavy weight sitting on my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did this start?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About three days ago, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it travel to your neck or shoulder?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, it goes down my left arm a little.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not taken anything for it.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it come on when you are active?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it comes even when I am sitting.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have trouble breathing with it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I feel winded.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any dizziness or lightheadedness?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not fainted.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or clammy when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I get clammy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure, and I have high cholesterol. I quit smoking years ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has anyone in your family had heart trouble at a young age?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My father had a heart attack in his fifties.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any past heart operations or procedures?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I had a stent put in a few years back.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you tell me your daily medicines?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel, Lisinopril and Atorvastatin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before you go, let me go over the plan. First, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Second, call 911 if the pain gets worse or does not stop. Can you tell me back what the plan is, so I know I was clear?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will get the heart tracing and the blood test today and call 911 if the pain gets worse or will not stop.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is there anything else you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, that is all, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thank you for coming in. Take care.
